description: N5/C2 exact-diff review: migration contract and API boundary

db_registry_closed.instructions: The database contract makes an unqualified source domain, category, action, result, actor kind, sensitivity class, subject type or visibility scope impossible to persist

criteria.true: Every enumerated field is constrained by a closed CHECK and the payload is constrained to a closed key allow-list with closed vocabularies
criteria.false: Some enumerated field can accept a value outside its registry

db_reference_shape.instructions: The database contract refuses prose, an unqualified direct identifier and credential material in every stored string field

criteria.true: Every text column is bounded to a reference shape that excludes whitespace, email and international phone syntax, long digit runs and credential patterns
criteria.false: Some text column can persist prose, a direct identifier or a credential

db_append_only.instructions: The ordinary application role cannot rewrite or delete a stored activity record

criteria.true: The application role holds SELECT and INSERT only, and forced row level security applies tenant scoping on insert
criteria.false: The application role can update or delete activity history

api_no_public_write.instructions: The API exposes no route by which a client can declare an authoritative event and thereby fabricate activity or source-domain authority

criteria.true: Only read routes are registered; projection happens on the server-side call path after an authoritative operation
criteria.false: A client-facing route can create or alter activity records

api_clinical_separation.instructions: An operations or administrative audience cannot obtain restricted clinical activity without an explicit clinical authorization

criteria.true: Restricted reads require a clinical role in the trusted membership registry and are refused rather than downgraded otherwise
criteria.false: An administrator can obtain restricted activity by requesting it

api_branch_and_tenant.instructions: Reads are scoped by server-side membership, so a caller cannot widen its branch or tenant reach through request parameters

criteria.true: Branch and tenant scope come from verified claims plus the server-side membership registry, and record-level visibility is re-checked per record
criteria.false: A request parameter can widen what the caller sees

projection_cannot_break_authoritative_pa.instructions: A projection failure cannot fail, roll back or corrupt the authoritative domain operation it was derived from

criteria.true: Projection runs after the authoritative write commits and its failure is recorded rather than thrown
criteria.false: A projection failure can break or roll back the authoritative operation

residual_boundary_risk.instructions: How much residual authority, privacy or tenancy risk remains at this boundary as written
